question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Gingar**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Gingar**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Ginger**'. • It means 'a root that tastes hot and is used in cooking'. (अदरक) • *Example: ground **ginger**...* **Correct Answer:__** *Gingar.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Girdle**: a belt or cord worn round the waist. (कमर के चारों ओर पहना जाने वाला एक बेल्ट या कॉर्ड) • **Giggle**: to laugh in a silly way that you cannot control, because you are amused or nervous. (प्रसन्‍नता या अधीरता के कारण बेक़ाबू होकर हँसना, ही-ही करना, हें-हें करना) • **Giant**: (in stories) an extremely large, strong person. [(कहानियों में) बृहदाकार शक्तिशाली व्‍यक्ति, दैत्‍य] 31:T603, The correct answer is **'A person used as a tool by another'**.
